# Skribly

> Skribly is a non-commercial family of developer tools: Skribly Agent (a desktop app for AI coding agents), agent-skills (portable skills for eight coding agents), Skribly Tracker (an issue tracker with a REST API for agents) and the shared Core and UI packages.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://docs.skribly.pl/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Skribly, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://docs.skribly.pl/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Skribly
- [Agent](https://docs.skribly.pl/_llms-txt/agent.txt): Skribly Agent, the desktop app for AI coding agents
- [Skills](https://docs.skribly.pl/_llms-txt/skills.txt): agent-skills, portable skills for eight coding agents
- [Tracker](https://docs.skribly.pl/_llms-txt/tracker.txt): Skribly Tracker, the issue tracker with a REST API for agents
- [Core](https://docs.skribly.pl/_llms-txt/core.txt): the shared Core package: contracts, events and connecting
- [UI](https://docs.skribly.pl/_llms-txt/ui.txt): the shared UI package and the site kit

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
